name: PyRunner
description: Execute a python command periodically, with defined (and adjustable) periodicity. See PeriodicEngine documentation for details.

attributes.name: command
attributes.description: Command to be run by python interpreter. Not run if empty.

attributes.name: ignoreErrors
attributes.description: Debug only: set this value to true to tell PyRunner to ignore any errors encountered during command execution.

attributes.name: initRun
attributes.description: Run the first time we are called as well.

attributes.name: iterPeriod
attributes.description: Periodicity criterion using step number (deactivated if <= 0)

attributes.name: nDo
attributes.description: Limit number of executions by this number (deactivated if negative)

attributes.name: realPeriod
attributes.description: Periodicity criterion using real (wall clock, computation, human) time in seconds (deactivated if <=0)

attributes.name: updateGlobals
attributes.description:
Whether to workaround `ipython not recognizing local variables <https://github.com/ipython/ipython/issues/62>`__
by calling ``globals().update(locals())``. If ``true`` then PyRunner is able to call functions declared later locally in a running **live** yade session.
The ``PyRunner`` call is a bit slower because it updates ``globals()`` with recently declared python functions.

.. warning::
	When ``updateGlobals==False`` and a function was declared inside a *live* yade session (`ipython <http://ipython.org>`_)
	then an error ``NameError: name 'command' is not defined`` will occur unless python ``globals()`` are updated with command

	.. code-block:: python

		globals().update(locals())

attributes.name: virtPeriod
attributes.description: Periodicity criterion using virtual (simulation) time (deactivated if <= 0)
